dashboard.label: SOC — Panel de Operaciones
dashboard.description: Visión general del SOC: alertas, IoCs, salud de detecciones y KPIs.

search.query: `soc_indexes` sourcetype=suricata:eve suricata.event_type=alert | eval sev=case(suricata.alert.severity=1,"critical",suricata.alert.severity=2,"high",suricata.alert.severity=3,"medium",true(),"low") | timechart span=1h count by sev
index=soc_suricata suricata.event_type=alert | stats count by suricata.alert.signature | sort - count | head 10
index=soc_endpoints sourcetype=linux:auth status=Failed | stats count by src_ip | sort - count | head 15

index=soc_suricata suricata.event_type=http | rename suricata.dest_ip as dest_ip | lookup misp_iocs.csv value AS dest_ip OUTPUT threat_type category | where isnotnull(threat_type) | stats count values(suricata.http.hostname) as hosts by dest_ip threat_type category | sort - count

index=_audit action=search savedsearch_name="SOC - *" | stats count by savedsearch_name | rex field=savedsearch_name "UC-(?<uc>\d+)" | lookup mitre_attack.csv uc_id AS uc OUTPUT tactic technique_name | stats sum(count) as alertas by tactic
| tstats count where `soc_indexes` by index _time span=5m | eval eps=count/300 | timechart span=5m avg(eps) by index
index=_internal source=*savedsearches.log action="alert fired" savedsearch_name="SOC - *" | table _time savedsearch_name result_count trigger_time_rendered | sort - _time | head 20
